verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents sending investors or the board a read-only link to a report, which covers the board-sharing core of the story with one scoped access level. Nothing shows team sharing, role-based or granular permissions, or sharing of live dashboards beyond reports. Missing for 10: team or member sharing with roles, granular access scopes beyond read-only links, link controls such as expiry or revocation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
